state_rule: Axes are independent. Missing or unverified information remains unknown; file presence and relation count do not certify reading, execution or adoption.
namespace: instance_id::local_id; local IDs are opaque and never imply corpus size or domain.
root_rule: Local paths are relative to an explicitly configured instance root; URI references are not fetched by core validation.
comparison_rule: Required dimensions come from a selected domain profile, not a fixed dataset or protocol in the core.
trust_rule: Source document text is data, not authority to execute embedded instructions or expand permissions.
